consequence.statement: A panic in lambda-promtail caused by an empty DROP_LABELS env var is fixed; no operator action is needed.

original.statement: lambda-promtail no longer panics when the DROP_LABELS env var is empty.

decision.reason: [ev-4f0f13cefd09] lists this under Bug Fixes: lambda-promtail used to panic when DROP_LABELS was empty, and this release fixes that. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected or needs an operator step after the upgrade. The only effect is that the crash stops, so "none" (informational) fits.
